story.title: Story 1: Thread And Thread View Inspection

result.planSummary: Implemented Story 1 end-to-end: added fixture snapshot reads and `activeThreadViewId` patch support to the canonical thread store, added a file-backed `ThreadViewStore` with list/open/create reads plus active-pointer reconciliation, added `WorkbenchQueryService` for managed-thread and fixture inspection, and added 12 new unit tests covering Story 1 ACs plus the reconciliation and cheap-active-lookup non-TCs. Targeted tests and `npm run verify-all` pass; `npm run green-verify` fails only because `guard:no-test-changes` rejects the newly added untracked Story 1 test files.

changedFiles.reason: Added fixture snapshot read contract and `activeThreadViewId` metadata patch support needed by Story 1 inspection.
Implemented `openFixture`, reusable snapshot loading, and persisted `activeThreadViewId` updates for thread/view reconciliation.
Defined the Story 1 Thread View store contract used by the query service and tests.
Implemented file-backed Thread View persistence under `thread-views/`, plus list/open reads and active-pointer reconciliation.
Implemented the Story 1 inspection flow for managed threads and fixtures, including usable/degraded/blocked reporting.
Added store coverage for Thread View persistence, listing/opening, and startup reconciliation of active-view state.
Added Story 1 AC coverage for thread inspection, active-view inspection, fixture reads, degraded reporting, and cheap active lookup.

findingsFixed: Reconciled stale `thread.json.activeThreadViewId` pointers to the authoritative per-view active state during Thread View reads.
Refreshed the source thread after pointer reconciliation so `openThread` returns the repaired source-vs-active-view state instead of stale metadata.
Kept fixture inspection on the same result shape and shared builder path as managed-thread inspection rather than introducing a fixture-only surface.
findingsSurfaced: `npm run green-verify` is blocked by `guard:no-test-changes` because Story 1 necessarily adds new test files, even though `npm run verify-all` passes.

openQuestions: Tech-design Q1 is still open: this implementation keeps fixture inspection source-thread-only and does not persist or load fixture-local Thread Views.
result.recommendedNextStep: Resolve the `guard:no-test-changes` policy for story-added tests (for example by committing the new test files to establish a clean baseline), then rerun `npm run green-verify`.
